title: Max for Live device description
description: What a Max for Live device is and what each of its parameters does, for a language model or a controller script. Written by describe.py from the device file.

name.description: The device's file name, without .amxd: the name Live shows.

about.description: The device's own Info text, if its builder wrote one.

parameters.description: Every parameter Live sees, in the patch's order.

name.description: The long name: what Live's API, automation and mappings call it.

short_name.description: What Push and the device show.

about.description: What it does: the Info View text Live shows on hover.

visibility.description: automatable: automation, mapping and Push reach it; stored: saved with the set, not automatable; hidden: neither.

range.description: [min, max], in the parameter's own unit.

unit_format.description: With unit custom: Live's format string, e.g. '%0.1f x'.

curve.description: The knob's exponent: a control's value is min + (max - min) * position ** curve.

options.description: A choice's options, in order: its value is the index.

default.description: Where it starts: a number, or a choice's option; null if the device sets none.

push.description: Where it sits on Push's pages: null if on none.

push_pages.description: The pages the device defines for Push, in order; empty if Live makes its own.

parameters.description: Long names, a slot each; null for an empty slot.
